card.name: Digits inside numbers and fractions
card.fires_on: Digits and decimal points partway through a number, often right after a slash or in a ratio, percentage or f-stop. Also a few spots in geometry talk, such as right angles and square roots.

modes.label: Number after slash
modes.description: A digit or point inside a fraction, count or ratio in tables or conversions.

modes.label: Decimal point in a rate
modes.description: The point inside a percentage or f-number.

modes.label: Geometry wording
modes.description: Linking words in text about angles, triangles or roots.
modes.example: vertex of a right angle<< whose>> sides are formed

card.writes: It nudges output toward diagonal and AC-type geometry words and away from triangle terms.
card.plain: It fires inside numbers like fractions and percentages, with a faint link to geometry words.
